# What hyprctl 0.57.1 writes to Hyprland's socket for each command line (recorded against a stand-in socket in a sandbox,
# never the running session): the command line, then the bytes sent. yggdrasil-wm sends the same (tests/hyprland.rs).
-j clients	j/clients
-j monitors	j/monitors
-j workspaces	j/workspaces
-j activeworkspace	j/activeworkspace
-j activewindow	j/activewindow
-j cursorpos	j/cursorpos
-j getoption cursor:inactive_timeout	j/getoption cursor:inactive_timeout
activewindow -j	j/activewindow
dispatch hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = "special:minimized", follow = false, window = "address:0xabc" })	/dispatch hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = "special:minimized", follow = false, window = "address:0xabc" })
dispatch hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "l" })	/dispatch hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "l" })
dispatch hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 960, y = 1000 })	/dispatch hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 960, y = 1000 })
eval hl.config({ cursor = { inactive_timeout = 0.25 } })	/eval hl.config({ cursor = { inactive_timeout = 0.25 } })
dispatch hl.dsp.window.close()	/dispatch hl.dsp.window.close()
dispatch sendshortcut CTRL SHIFT, V, activewindow	/dispatch sendshortcut CTRL SHIFT, V, activewindow
dispatch sendshortcut CTRL, V, activewindow	/dispatch sendshortcut CTRL, V, activewindow
reload	/reload
setcursor Yggdrasil 24	/setcursor Yggdrasil 24
configerrors	/configerrors
-j monitors all	j/monitors all
-j binds	j/binds
clients -j	j/clients
-j layers	j/layers
dispatch hl.dsp.focus({ window = "class:org.example.Settings" })	/dispatch hl.dsp.focus({ window = "class:org.example.Settings" })
dispatch hl.dsp.window.close({ window = "address:0xabc" })	/dispatch hl.dsp.window.close({ window = "address:0xabc" })
dispatch hl.dsp.exit()	/dispatch hl.dsp.exit()
eval hl.config({ input = { kb_layout = "us", kb_variant = "" } })	/eval hl.config({ input = { kb_layout = "us", kb_variant = "" } })
